si_4_title: Individual deviations from normative models of brain structure in a large cross-sectional schizophrenia cohort

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Participants were from the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB), which provided structural and diffusion-weighted MRI, genetic data, and clinical assessments.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Here, we developed normative models of FA and CT across the lifespan using harmonized MRI data from healthy adults (18 -65 years) participating in the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank [28].

answer.ASRB: normative training/validation (healthy controls) and clinical research (schizophrenia patients)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy comparison individuals (n=195) were used to establish the normative range and verify model validity via cross-validation. Adults with schizophrenia (n=322) were evaluated for individual deviations from these ranges.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: normative ranges of variation in FA and CT for each tract and region, respectively, were established based on the healthy comparison individuals (n = 195)... Individual deviations from the normative range were then determined for more than 300 adults with schizophrenia.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Lv2021.pdf.md: Results / Individual deviation from normative range, Paragraph 1; Introduction, Paragraph 5

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: The study utilized 195 healthy comparison individuals to build the normative models. For model validation, a 10-fold cross-validation approach was used where 175 individuals were assigned to the training set and 20 to the test set.
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.supporting_text: normative ranges of variation in FA and CT for each tract and region, respectively, were established based on the healthy comparison individuals (n = 195)... percentile curves were fitted using a randomly selected subset of healthy individuals (n = 175, training set) and the proportion of remaining healthy individuals residing within the 5 -95% percentiles (normative range) was enumerated (n = 20, test set).
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.location: study_1/Lv2021.pdf.md: Results / Individual deviation from normative range, Paragraph 1 & 2

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age info for the healthy control group (n=195) is reported in Supplementary Table 1. The age range for healthy adults is specified as 18-65 years in the Introduction. Statistics for the specific training subset (n=175) used in cross-validation are not reported.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: Age: Mean 40.3, SD 14.0 (Supplementary Table 1); healthy adults (18 -65 years) (Introduction).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The healthy control group (n=195) consisted of 97 males and 98 females. Percentages were calculated from these values. Statistics for the training subset (n=175) used in cross-validation are not reported.
